rubric.title: Fellow Performance Rubric
rubric.description: 1-10 scale assessing Fellow performance based on supervisor feedback

levels.label: Disengaged / Absent
levels.description: Fellow is rarely present, contributes nothing, supervisor sees no value. Relationships are poor or absent.

levels.label: Present but Ineffective
levels.description: Fellow shows up and tries but produces little visible output. May be learning but hasn't contributed yet.

levels.label: Reliable and Productive
levels.description: Fellow does assigned work well. Supervisor sees value. Some proactivity. Beginning to build systems or structures.

levels.label: Proactive and Trusted
levels.description: Fellow proactively identifies and solves problems. Team trusts them. Building systems that outlast their presence.

levels.label: Transformational
levels.description: Fellow has changed how the organization operates. Impact is visible, measurable, and sustainable. Supervisor sees them as essential.
indicators: Fellow has built systems that run without them

dimensions.name: Presence & Reliability
dimensions.description: Does the Fellow show up consistently and follow through on commitments?

dimensions.name: Proactivity
dimensions.description: Does the Fellow identify problems and act without being told?

dimensions.name: Systems Building
dimensions.description: Is the Fellow creating structures, processes, or tools that outlast them?

dimensions.name: Team Relationships
dimensions.description: How does the Fellow interact with the team? Do people trust and include them?

dimensions.name: Founder / Supervisor Relationship
dimensions.description: How does the supervisor/owner perceive the Fellow? Is there trust?

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.description: Does the Fellow communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and keep people informed?

dimensions.name: Domain Learning
dimensions.description: Is the Fellow learning the business context quickly enough to contribute?

dimensions.name: Impact Visibility
dimensions.description: Can the supervisor point to specific things that changed because of the Fellow?

kpis.name: Operational Efficiency
kpis.description: Reduction in waste, rework, or delays in production/logistics

kpis.name: Accountability Systems
kpis.description: Daily review structures, MIS reports, checklists that track execution

kpis.name: Team Capability
kpis.description: Upskilling of floor workers or managers; training systems

kpis.name: Founder Leverage
kpis.description: Freeing up the founder's time by building delegation structures

kpis.name: Data Visibility
kpis.description: Installing metrics, dashboards, or reporting that give leadership real-time information

kpis.name: Problem Resolution Speed
kpis.description: Faster identification and fixing of recurring operational problems

kpis.name: Vendor / Customer Management
kpis.description: Improved coordination with suppliers or customers

kpis.name: Culture & Discipline
kpis.description: Improvements in punctuality, cleanliness, adherence to SOPs, team morale
